name: axis_formats/categories
description: A weekly electricity-use plot whose horizontal axis shows day names instead of numbers. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore tabs, headings, descriptions, and other surrounding UI.

checks.expectation: One coherent category plot is visible with its axes, grid, and curve. Do not evaluate tabs or other content outside the plot.

Day names appear below the plot as tick labels instead of numbers, starting with Mon at the left and ending with Sun at the right. The Electricity use (kWh) vertical axis is also present with numeric labels. Report uncertain rather than fail when individual names are too small to read.

A connected line with a diamond marker at each of the seven days is visible, with the highest value at Sat. Markers at the left and right plot borders may be partly clipped by the plot area by design.

Within the plot, axis titles and tick labels are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, tabs, buttons, controls, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
The plot, grid, ticks, line, markers, and plot text are visually distinguishable; no plot element is blank or corrupted, and axis titles and tick labels are not cut off.
